target_pattern: Use preterite for completed past actions with time anchors, including regular endings, high-frequency irregulars, and key spelling or stem shifts.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one generic past form without marking completed actions.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Preterite packages an action as finished, especially with specific past-time cues such as ayer, anoche, and el ano pasado.
target_pattern_formula: completed action plus specific time marker uses preterite
regular ar endings: e, aste, o, amos, aron
regular er and ir endings: i, iste, io, imos, ieron
frequent irregulars: fui, hice, tuve, estuve, pude, dije, vine, vi, di
yo spelling shifts and third-person ir stem shifts
natural_examples: Estuvimos en casa toda la noche.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using the preterite.
prompts_en: Did you study for the exam last night?
He bought a car last year.
They arrived late to the party.
Did you listen to the song?
Were you able to finish the work?
I gave the keys to my friend.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Hable con ella ayer. -> change subject to tu.
Base: Comi tacos anoche. -> change object to ensalada.
Base: Fuimos a la tienda. -> change subject to yo.
Base: El dijo la verdad. -> make it negative.
Base: Estuviste en casa anoche. -> change to question form.
Base: Tuviste tiempo para estudiar. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Pude terminar el trabajo. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Vinieron a la fiesta. -> change to singular el.
Base: Vi una pelicula. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Di las llaves a mi amigo. -> change recipient to mi hermana.
Base: Busque mi telefono. -> change verb to pagar and object to la cuenta.
Base: Comence la clase temprano. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: El durmio ocho horas. -> change subject to ellos.
Base: Ella pidio ayuda. -> change subject to ellos.
Base: Hiciste la tarea ayer. -> change to question form with tu.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the correct Spanish form for a completed event.
prompts: I ate tacos. (Comi tacos. vs Comia tacos.)
I went to the store yesterday. (Fui a la tienda ayer. vs Iba a la tienda ayer.)
She told me the truth. (Me dijo la verdad. vs Me decia la verdad.)
We were at home all night as one completed event. (Estuvimos en casa toda la noche. vs Estabamos en casa toda la noche.)
I saw a movie last night. (Vi una pelicula anoche. vs Veia una pelicula anoche.)
They came to the party. (Vinieron a la fiesta. vs Venian a la fiesta.)
I gave him the money. (Le di el dinero. vs Le daba el dinero.)
Were you able to finish it? (Pudiste terminarlo? vs Podias terminarlo?)
I had time to study. (Tuve tiempo para estudiar. vs Tenia tiempo para estudiar.)
What did you do yesterday? (Que hiciste ayer? vs Que hacias ayer?)

reverse_conceptual_expression.instructions: Write natural Spanish, not literal English.
prompts_en: Did you talk to Ana yesterday?
They were able to finish on time.
I told him that I went to the store.
Why did you come so late?

common_errors.why_it_happens: Using imperfect for a completed event.
Mixing person endings with ir and ser preterite.

common_errors.mistake: Busce or pague without spelling awareness

common_errors.why_it_happens: Applying plural third person to singular subject.
Using third person irregular with nosotros.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Not anchoring event completion in context.
